page.title: Privacy policy
page.lede: Coinio has no ads, does not track you and does not sell data. This page explains exactly what the hosted version at app.getcoinio.me keeps, and how to take it with you or delete it.
legal.body:
Who we are

Coinio at app.getcoinio.me is a free, hosted version of the open-source Coinio subscription tracker. If you run Coinio on your own server, this policy does not apply: your data never reaches us. Questions about privacy go to support@getcoinio.me.

What we store

  • Your email address and, if you set one, a password stored only as a one-way hash (argon2id).
  • If you sign in with Google or GitHub: the account ID they give us and your verified email address. We never see your password there and ask for no other permission.
  • What you enter in the app: subscriptions, payments, categories, notes, settings, appearance and notification channels.
  • Technical data needed to run the service: sign-in sessions, the time of your last sign-in, and your IP address for a short time to stop abuse (rate limits and the Cloudflare Turnstile check).

Why we store it

Only to run your account: showing your subscriptions, sending the reminders you turn on, keeping your account safe and answering your questions. The legal basis is providing the service you signed up for.

Who else handles it

  • Netvay (servers in Türkiye) hosts the application and its database.
  • Cloudflare protects and delivers the site, runs the Turnstile bot check and stores encrypted nightly backups in the EU.
  • Brevo (EU) sends account emails and the reminders you choose to receive by email.
  • Google and GitHub, only if you use them to sign in.

Cookies

One cookie keeps you signed in. Turnstile may set its own cookie for the bot check. There are no advertising or analytics cookies.

How long we keep it

  • As long as your account exists. When you delete it, everything is removed from the live database at once and from backups within 14 days.
  • Accounts that are never verified are deleted after 7 days.

Your rights

You can download all of your data (Settings › Account › Download my data), correct it in the app, or delete your account at any time. Under the GDPR and Türkiye’s KVKK you may also ask about your data or object to its use: write to support@getcoinio.me.

Children

Coinio is for everyone and is not a service made for children. If a parent or guardian believes a child under 13 has created an account, write to support@getcoinio.me and we will delete the account and all of its data.

Changes

If this policy changes in a way that matters, we tell you by email or in the app before it takes effect.
